csv_scope_of_work: The Town of Holden Beach ( Town ) is seeking qualified providers of Engineering services for the underwater inspection of the below water substructure elements of the Town pier to develop estimates that will enable the Town to make repair or rebuild decisions regarding its Pier Complex located at 441 Ocean Boulevard West, Holden Beach NC. The Town is seeking to contract with a firm or team of qualified firms having multi-faceted experience working with marine/waterfront public facility projects. Such experience may include, but is not necessarily limited to, the following: - Civil Engineering with specific coastal engineering and/or marine design and construction experience - Structural Engineering - Survey - Environmental Services and Permits Including CAMA Permitting - Cost Estimating
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Cost Estimating, Inspection Services, Biological Studies/Natural Resources, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Structural Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
